Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics part of this study focuses on interactome mapping via affinity purification of endogenously tagged subunits. While the broader study includes differential analysis (AID-mediated knockdown of METTL3 and CPSF4), the MS data deposited in PXD024326 specifically describes the composition of the CPSF and m6A writer complexes using tagged lines. Therefore, the primary biological variable for the MS experiment is the specific tagged protein used as bait for the interactome.
